label: clean
provenance: Self-contained synthetic fixture authored for V4.3. Development scenario; not eligible for an unseen holdout.

expectation.rationale: buckets.py establishes whether the default list is modified. The helper always constructs a fresh list and never mutates its argument. The default remains empty; the explicit None branch is retained, so omitted, None and explicit-list arguments all preserve their behavior.
false_positive_traps: A list default proves a state leak even when no operation mutates it.
